attempts.prompt:
EDIT ONLY THE PERSON in image 1. Image 1 is the exact original game portrait/card and the sole authority for visible features, composition, clothing and exterior. Image 2 is only the user mascot identity reference: a fictional yellow 奶龙 with a compact round head, short broad neck, solid black oval eyes with green rings and no white sclera, one small mouth at the actual original mouth position, and no human nose, ears or skin. If a moustache is present, the one mouth remains below it; never add a second gray slit or default mascot lip above the moustache.

SOURCE-VISIBLE FEATURES TO PRESERVE:
Dark olive peaked officer cap with a dark brown band, gold eagle, gold wreath around a round cockade, gold braided cords/piping and a shiny black visor with gold embroidery above it; hair and hairline are covered, with short brown sideburns near the ears. Thick brown eyebrows and one short full brown moustache across the upper lip; no beard and a visibly clean-shaven smooth chin, with no glasses. Dark olive uniform with red gold-embroidered collar tabs, gold shoulder boards, one black-and-white neck cross, a multicolored ribbon bar and small lower decorations clipped by the crop.
Retain the actual source hair, eyebrows, facial-hair extent, headgear, eyewear, clothing and decorations only where visibly present. Do not copy a bare scalp or missing eyebrows from the mascot reference over real source hair. Do not invent features from names or biographies.

COMPOSITION, EXPRESSION AND LIGHT:
Preserve the near-frontal square-shouldered head-and-upper-chest portrait, direct stern gaze, closed mouth beneath the moustache, cap near the top edge and chest decorations cut by the bottom. Retain the original soft frontal illumination, cap shadow and restrained metallic highlights.
Fit the existing collar naturally around a rounded chin and very short broad neck transition while preserving its original open/closed state. No long neck column, pinched collar, floating cloth, clipping or cream bib. Preserve exactly one source-appropriate mouth and expression.

BACKGROUND, FRAME AND EXTERIOR:
Real full-rectangle opaque pale grey-beige photographic/painted backing, including every corner: lock its lightly mottled texture, warm pale center, muted edge shading and original illumination. Do not replace it with transparency, a figure cutout, neutral matte, new interior, halo, smoke, frame or note.

OPAQUE RGB WORKING PASS AND EVIDENCE LIMITS:
This is the authorized best-RGB pass. Source alpha will be restored separately only after actual visual RGB review, using the recorded source-alpha BILINEAR method without changing RGB. Do not request or paint a checkerboard or green screen. Keep all original opaque backing, cloth and paper solid; no interior holes, haze or see-through fabric. Individual ribbon cells and the tiniest cap, collar and lower-chest decorations are not reliably readable at 156x210. Do not invent readable writing, extra note rows, symbols, people or comparison panels. Keep full returned detail and the source composition; no watermark.
